newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt overnight, one week rates up in flush market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt overnight, one week rates up in flush market.

text.p: Egyptian overnight interbank rates rose on Monday in a private sector market liquid with funds left from a Central Bank bond offer between 10 and 10 1/8 percent from Thursday's 9 1/4 and 9 3/4 percent, bankers said.
Banks were closed on Sunday for a public holiday.
"No one is interested in overnight dealings now," one banker said.
The Central Bank last week offered seven-year bonds worth four billion pounds and received applications for bonds worth 10.119 billion. The bonds carry a fixed interest rate of 11 percent.
One week rates were also up between 9 3/4 and 10 1/8 percent from between 9 3/8 to 10 3/8 percent.
Public-sector banks rate maintained minimum overnight lending rates at 10.5 percent.
